decisions.decision: Phase 24 runbooks pin SIF_MODEL_TYPE=modelscope and the Qwen3 cache id modelscope:Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B; the Phase 23 saved run is reused only when corpus fingerprint + model_type/model_name match, otherwise a fresh baseline is generated.
decisions.rationale: Different backends produce incompatible vectors; the sweep must isolate chunking/breadcrumb, not a backend swap.

decisions.decision: The chunk sweep grid is 512/128 (baseline), 448/112, 512/64, 512/0, 384/96, 256/64; max_tokens stays 512 and is not varied.
decisions.rationale: max_tokens is not in the cache key and >512 is out of scope; a small grid includes the default.

decisions.decision: Breadcrumb = heading-path prefix on the embedding input only; Settings embed_breadcrumb default False; stored chunk content/FTS unchanged; adoption requires an overall held-out win plus a winning body leg, rejecting title-leg-only/duplicate-signal gains.
decisions.rationale: Title is already indexed by title FTS; the breadcrumb must add value beyond it.

decisions.decision: sif models pull/status implemented; sif pull is a hidden deprecated alias; canonical cache <Settings.get_cache_dir()>/models/<owner>/<name> with a SHA-256 .sif-model.json manifest; DEFAULT_MODELS corrected to the Qwen3-0.6B family (D-09).
decisions.rationale: Deterministic, cache-honest model management with the identity/status scope D-08 requires.

decisions.decision: uv-first install docs use `uv tool install --torch-backend=cpu 'docsif[embed]'`, a degradation matrix, and client snippets; generator-owned docs go through make docs-generate.
decisions.rationale: Linux PyPI torch is CUDA; the uv flag is the correct CPU recipe.
